How the work is organized

Design-build vs. a general contractor

Most remodel stress is not tile. It is the gap between the drawing, the bid, and the house.

Request a consultation Explore kitchen design ideas

A common path: hire a designer, take those drawings to several general contractors, pick the low number, then discover the house and the drawings disagree. Another path: one design-build team holds planning, permitting coordination, and construction so those disagreements get solved before demolition.

RT Signature Homes works as a design-build remodeler from Redmond. This article is the statewide explainer. It is not a claim that every other firm on the Eastside is a bid-only GC.

What a general contractor bid usually assumes

A GC bid is often a price to build a defined set of documents. That can be the right model when:

  • The drawings already match the house
  • Selections are decided
  • You want independent design and independent build
  • You have time and a consultant to reconcile conflicts

It is a weak model when the documents are still a mood board, the structure is unknown, or three bidders are guessing at different scopes.

What design-build is for

Design-build puts investigation, design, permitting coordination, and construction in one accountable relationship. The point is not a prettier brochure. The point is that the person who will build the kitchen is in the room when the kitchen is planned.

That matters when:

  • You are changing layout, structure, or systems
  • The house is occupied
  • Permits and inspections will shape the sequence
  • You do not want a designer and a builder blaming each other

On Seattle and Eastside projects, access, weather, occupancy, and which city reviews the work all affect that sequence. See Kitchen remodeling in Seattle and the Eastside and ADU builder in Seattle and the Eastside for how that plays out in a specific scope.

What this is not

Design-build is not a promise of a lower price. It is not a satisfaction guarantee. It is not a reason to skip checking that the firm is actually registered in Washington.

See How to pick a licensed remodeler in Washington.

How to use a first conversation

Ask either kind of firm:

  • Who owns the drawings if conditions change?
  • Who pulls the permit?
  • What is still unknown about this house?
  • What would make you decline the job?

We use a project consultation to answer those against your property, not to race a GC quote. Read What a project consultation covers.

Questions homeowners ask

Does design-build cost less?

Not as a promise. The value is one accountable path for planning, permits, and construction. Price still follows the property, scope, and selections.

Can I still hire a separate designer?

You can. Then you are closer to a GC model. The drawings, the house, and the builder still have to agree.

Will the first call give me a number I can compare to three bids?

Complex residential work needs the property, existing conditions, scope, and selections before a responsible recommendation.

Is this only for whole-home work?

No. Kitchens, bathrooms, additions, and ADUs all fail when design and construction are disconnected. Fit still depends on the project.
